thread:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for release v2.3.1 -> enabling feature flag `burst_control_v2` in eu-west-1. initial cohort = 5%

maya: heads-up — plan is soft-unpin after soak, we want a controlled burst for search indexing traffic.

chris: proposed ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. timings: 30m soak at 5, 30m at 25, then evaluate.

rachel: add explicit safety gates: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency > 600ms should auto-pause. also watch token-level cost spike.

jeremy: agreed. can we make the pause auto-freeze and notify #eng-oncall?

maya: yes — deployctl supports gating. snippet I'm going to apply: 
```
flag: burst_control_v2
rollout:
  - pct: 5
    duration: 30m
  - pct: 25
    duration: 30m
  - pct: 50
    duration: 20m
  - pct: 100
    duration: 10m
safety:
  error_rate: 0.005  # 0.5%
  p95_latency_ms: 600
  cost_delta_pct: 40
```

chris: looks good. who will press the soft-unpin to 25%? I can do it but prefer ops to trigger if alerts fire.

oncall: I'll stay on watch for next 2 hours. set pager thresholds to include a token-cost surge.

maya: ok i'll kick it off now. command: `deployctl ff set burst_control_v2 5 --region eu-west-1 --meta "release=v2.3.1"`

deploy-bot: `deployctl` applied: burst_control_v2 = 5% in eu-west-1 by maya (run id rr-20260320-01).

sre-alerts-bot: Monitoring: metrics streaming -> errors, p95 latency, infra GPU queue length, token_cost. Alerts configured to notify #eng-oncall.

20m later — maya: preliminary metrics look fine (errors 0.08%, p95 ~430ms). I'll queue the soft-unpin to 25%.

maya: `deployctl ff set burst_control_v2 25 --reason "soft-unpin warmup"`

deploy-bot: command accepted, starting shift to 25% (gradual ramp over 2 minutes).

sre-alerts-bot: Alert rule check: p95 450ms -> OK, error_rate 0.12% -> OK, cost delta 12% -> OK.

chris: good to continue to 50 after 30m if stable. leave the auto-pause rule enabled.

~12m after soft-unpin — sre-alerts-bot: ALERT: p95_latency_ms exceeded threshold (current p95 680ms) for search-service in eu-west-1. check runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/ff-rollouts

oncall: I'm on it. rolling hold now.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 25% due to p95_latency_ms > 600ms (auto-pause). Burst_control_v2 remains pinned at 25% cohort. Notifying #eng-oncall and #eng-runtime.

rachel: noted. can someone grab flamegraphs + recent PRs touching attention kernel? might be a model variant or kernel regression. jeremy can you triage?

jeremy: looking at infra traces — GPU queue spiked for a specific shard serving short-context requests. suspect batching config interacting with new kernel.

chris: quick mitigation options? rollback to 5% or pin to 5 and investigate?

maya: let's soft-rollback to 5% to reduce blast radius, keep flag config but set cohort back. command in 2m if no objections.

oncall: thumbs up. I'll watch for noisy errors during the rollback.

maya: `deployctl ff set burst_control_v2 5 --reason "auto-pause rollback after p95 spike"`

deploy-bot: Applied: burst_control_v2 = 5% (rollback) by maya (run id rr-20260320-01-rollback). Rollout stay paused.

sre-alerts-bot: Resolving: p95 returned to ~420ms within 3m of rollback. No new errors.

rachel: ok great. jeremy, can you file a quick postmortem stub and pin the suspect kernel PR? include recommended follow-ups: re-evaluate batching heuristics, add a canary test that simulates short-context burst.

jeremy: will do. filing now. link: https://redwood/pm/pm-445-burst-kernel-investigation

chris: once root cause identified, plan to resume: staged roll 5 -> 25 (longer soak) -> 50 with a canary VM pinned to the new kernel. schedule any further ramp for off-peak window.

maya: agreed. closing this thread for now — flag remains at 5%. I'll reopen/notify when we're ready to resume. Thanks all :heart: 

deploy-bot: Rollout status: PAUSED. burst_control_v2 = 5% in eu-west-1. run id rr-20260320-01 (active)"
